approved_scope.title: Bind discovered Cargo crate sources during generation
approved_scope.description: Bind discovered Cargo crate sources during generation
acceptance_criteria: The issue #813 minimal Cargo library succeeds through init then generate, creates specs/demo/demo.spec.md bound to src/lib.rs and documents add. Text, JSON, and batch generation bind discovered Cargo sources; binary and workspace crates are scoped correctly; existing spec-owned files remain owned; missing configured modules still fail with skipped_no_files.

answers.constraints: Keep retained capability discovery and generation, bounded snapshots, configured-module precedence, deterministic templates, and no-overwrite publication. Bind only measured uncovered files; do not substitute a global single-source guess for a Cargo manifest mapping.
